text:
ashley: Heads-up: we just got a report that some engineers with the 'viewer' role could list KMS keys and access metadata in prod. I think a recent RBAC change touched role mappings.

jordan: Confirmed — saw noisy audit lines from 1752104300..1752104305 where viewer principals made GetKey requests. Not all viewers, but a subset.

matt: any deploys around that time?

deploy-bot: deploy 2025-10-12T11:45Z by @matt - config/rework/rbac-mapping.yaml applied to control-plane service.

jordan: here's the audit query I ran: 
```
SELECT timestamp, principal, action, resource
FROM audit_logs
WHERE action LIKE '%GetKey%'
AND timestamp >= '2025-10-12T11:40:00Z'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

tamara: if viewers can call GetKey that's a big regression. We need emergency mitigation: 1) revoke any active sessions that used viewer role, 2) rollback the RBAC mapping, 3) apply a deny policy to KMS for viewer role until fixed. Who can do the revoke now?

ashley: I can revoke sessions and apply a temporary deny. Doing ACL patch now: 
```
rwdctl auth deny-role --role viewer --resource kms:keys --reason "emergency temporary deny"
```

matt: rolling back the rbac-mapping deploy now. patching to previous commit sha: `c3f8a2b`.

jordan: added a watch query to track any more GetKey attempts from viewer: 
```
alert if count(GetKey from role=viewer) > 0 in 10m then notify #eng-security
```

sec-bot: 4 new alerts matched watch in the last 5m. Sending sig alerts to oncall.

ashley: revoke complete, deny policy applied. Running quick audit to list principals that succeeded earlier: 
```
SELECT principal, resource, timestamp
FROM audit_logs
WHERE action = 'GetKey' AND resource LIKE 'projects/%/kms/keys/%'
AND timestamp >= '2025-10-12T11:40:00Z'
```

matt: rollback finished — old mapping restored and validated against unit tests. Confirmed no viewer -> KMS grant in the policy diff.

tamara: ok immediate fix done. Next: root cause triage. Initial hypothesis: config key rename in mapping caused fallback to permissive role. We should check CI tests that validate deny semantics.

jordan: saving audit export to s3://redwood-security/audit-1752104321.csv for postmortem. Also capturing KMS key access logs.

ashley: action items: 
- jordan: full audit export + list of affected principals (due EOD)
- matt: PR with stricter unit + integration tests for RBAC mapping (due tomorrow)
- tamara: shepherd postmortem + communication to affected ENG teams (stakeholder list)
- sec team: add an automated smoke test that tries a forbidden GetKey from viewer in staging on every RBAC deploy.

matt: will also add a pre-deploy gating job to validate no role gains new KMS perms unless explicitly flagged.

tamara: escalate note for product/legal? Any customer data accessed? Jordan, auditors?

jordan: so far looks like metadata/list operations only, no Decrypt/UseKey actions. Still investigating.

ashley: opened incident ticket INC-2025-308 with severity S2. Tagging legal/ops for visibility.

sec-bot: incident INC-2025-308 created, owner=ashley, severity=S2.

matt: once postmortem draft is up I can link the offending commit + diff and our rollback timeline.

ashley: monitoring in place for 24h and deny policy stays until we push a verified fix. Will update channel with status. :lock: :thumbsup:

tamara: thanks team. After action: consider moving KMS access checks into pre-merge policy and add explicit allow-list for keys.

jordan: confirmed no new GetKey attempts in last 20m. Closing emergency loop for now, keeping incident open for triage.

ashley: closing thread for real-time updates. Postmortem link will be in INC ticket when ready.
